$comment: RFC 0220 §D — the GOVERNANCE.md §"Acceptance evidence tiers" table, keyed by the origin a bundle's discovery.url names, so scripts/check-ext-status-coherence.mjs can apply the ext/README.md `Stable` predicate (tier 2 or better) instead of trusting any certified bundle. An origin not listed here is unknown and never qualifies: a side revision, a tunnel or a loopback reference host is not a deployed tier-2 host. Adding a row is a governance act: cite the GOVERNANCE.md line that places the host.

hosts.name: myndhyve-legacy
hosts.source: GOVERNANCE.md §"Acceptance evidence tiers" — Tier 2, steward-affiliated sibling host: MyndHyve's legacy `workflow-runtime` (api.myndhyve.ai), retired 2026-10-29. Its certified bundles stay tier-2 evidence; no new bundle may be cut against it.

hosts.name: openwop-app
hosts.source: GOVERNANCE.md §"Acceptance evidence tiers" — Tier 1, the steward-operated demo app. `api.openwop.dev` is its API origin; `myndhyve.ai` is the MyndHyve white-label of the same codebase (2026-10-29), so it is tier 1, not tier 2.

hosts.name: openwop-host-v2-reference
hosts.source: GOVERNANCE.md §"Acceptance evidence tiers" — Tier 1, a reference host in openwop-examples
